title: Transcendence degree bounded by algebra-generators up to algebraicity
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $E$ a nonzero commutative $R$-algebra without zero divisors [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let $s\subseteq E$ be any set, and let $A\subseteq E$ be the smallest subring containing the image of $R$ and $s$ (the $R$-subalgebra generated by $s$). Suppose every $e\in E$ satisfies a nonzero polynomial with coefficients in $A$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], with evaluation through the inclusion $A\subseteq E$. Then $\operatorname{trdeg}_R E\leq |s|$ as cardinals, where transcendence degree is defined in [def-kun-transcendence-degree].
